species.name: Kookaburra
mustRead: huge dagger bill on an oversized head
dark brown eye stripe on a whitish head

species.name: Hoatzin
mustRead: bare blue face with a staring red eye
long broad tail and heavy chest over a slim neck

species.name: Quetzal
mustRead: two streaming tail plumes far longer than the body
metallic emerald green plumage over a crimson belly
round bristly helmet crest above a yellow bill
species.note: Interpreted as the resplendent quetzal. The streamers are elongated upper tail coverts, not the tail itself, and they hang far below a perched bird.

species.name: Weaverbird
mustRead: bright yellow plumage with a black face mask
clinging upside down to a woven grass nest
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a representative male village/southern masked weaver in breeding plumage.

species.name: Screamer
mustRead: thin curved horn projecting from the forehead
goose-like bulky body with a small chicken-like bill
sharp bony spurs on the wing bends
species.note: Interpreted as the horned screamer. Despite being related to waterfowl the feet are only partly webbed and the bill is short and hooked, not flat.
